ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio with approximately 85 percent high-intensity white pixels occupying the central surface area and 15 percent low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the margins and central vertical axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and distal tips. A prominent vertical black stripe extends from the median notch toward the lower fluke base. Distinct yellowish-tan contiguous patches are mapped adjacent to the lower central black axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute pixel angle of approximately 45-55 degrees and high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, jagged peaks near the distal tip. The left lobe exhibits lower-amplitude, high-frequency peaks along the mid-to-distal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile along the trailing edge from the median notch to the tips, transitioning to a convex curve on the leading edge towards the fluke base.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark-outlined ring clusters detected; approximately three distinct rings on the mid-left lobe and five scattered rings on the right lobe mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the distal right lobe. Subtle vertical linear rake-like marks observed near the lower central junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent central vertical dark scar/pigmentation at the notch junction; bilateral yellowish-tan epidermal patches adjacent to the central black column.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical distal tip pigmentation where the right tip displays a wider, blockier low-intensity black termination compared to the more tapered left tip.
